summary: The per-round receipt (CheckRun fda749eb6eb64986a3bd5e9a0c950849) settled the persistence question with every comparison complete: the control round without a forgery grants nothing (index 29), each of the three forged rounds grants the same retried pre-vote (32, 35, 38), and the two repair comparisons hold (33, 36) — so the window is not a single heartbeat interval, since a sender repeating the message each round keeps the follower's lease suppression off while the leader is healthy and still beating, and that is the sender's cadence defeating a working repair rather than a broken one. Recorded as a Fact, wrote the child account with conclusion violated, and revised the parent account so its limitation list no longer claims the repeated-message case is unexecuted, with joint_history covering the four receipts of the same lineage. Remaining scope limits: single process with hand-delivered messages and an exact one-message-per-tick cadence, the candidate's grants are not fed back, and the quorum-scale election was not re-measured under the repeated cadence.
